For: an oral taken with Lilly's own mirikizumab, which Lilly can sell as a combination, and a barrier-strengthening mechanism no approved IBD drug uses (Lilly's pipeline description). Against: its one efficacy study is a 60-patient open-label proof of concept; FXR314's IBD case rested on 3D human tissue models and preclinical data when Lilly bought it (VivoSim 10-Q, 0001193125-26-346820); an add-on adds a second drug cost to a biologic; and it would launch in 2035 behind the TL1A antibodies and the IL-23s
